categories.title: Carriage
categories.info: Used to cross the Lake of Mist and access the Third Sin DLC area. You'll need the [Lamp of the Whisper of the Mist](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=597329).

categories.title: Prie Dieu
categories.info: Resting at a Prie Dieu will restore your health & flasks, save your progress, and respawn enemies. When you die, you'll respawn at the last Prie Dieu you rested at. Additional features, like fast travel, can be unlocked with the help of the [Lady of the Cobijo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520762).

categories.title: Sculptor
categories.info: Visit the Sculptor's workshop to equip figures in your Altarpiece of Favours. Each one provides powerful effects, and can react differently when next to other specific Figures.

categories.title: Teleporter
categories.info: Teleporters are used to fast travel to any other teleporter you've entered.

categories.title: Child of Moonlight
categories.info: Speak to [Proximo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=522643) after finding all 33 Children of Moonlight to reach the top of the tower above him.

categories.title: Cobijadas
categories.info:
Speak to the [Lady of the Cobijo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520762) for upgrades after finding her sisters.

- 2 Sisters, 1500 Tears - Travel to the City from any Prie Dieu.
- 4 Sisters, 3000 Tears - Refill Fervour when resting at any Prie Dieu.
- 6 Sisters, 6000 Tears  - Fast travel between Prie Dieus.
- 9 Sisters, 12500 Tears - [Cobijada Mayor](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523470)

categories.title: Empty Receptacle
categories.info: Used to increase the number of Bile Flasks when presented to [Our Lady of the Chalices](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509170).

categories.title: Forgotten Tribute
categories.info: Forgotten Tributes are used to pay for journeys with the [Procession of Shadows](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520930).

categories.title: Hidden Symbol
categories.info: Use the [Chime of the Twisted One](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=522337) near hidden symbols for a total of [69100 tears](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523350) and the [Still Among Us](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523351) achievement.

categories.title: Imperfectus Lacrimatorio
categories.info: Gather all four Imperfectus Lacrimatorio to receive the [Beatus Lacrimatorio](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=524351), upgrading one Bile Flask to restore Fervour as well as Health.

categories.title: Lump of Gold
categories.info: Bring Lumps of Gold to the [Golden Tree](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=521026) for rewards. 10 can be found in the base game, with another 10 exclusive to Mea Culpa DLC areas.

categories.title: Memento
categories.info: Bring Mementos to [Montanes](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509092) to unlock new Figures. Gathering all of them unlocks [The Work of a Master](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523740) achievement.

categories.title: Offering
categories.info: Bring sets of Offerings to the [Altar](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=597394) to unlock Servants.

categories.title: Ornate Chalice
categories.info: Used to increase maximum health when presented to [Our Lady of the Chalices](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509170).

categories.title: Sealed Envelope
categories.info: Can be opened from your inventory's Quest Items screen.

categories.title: Silver-Clad Crystal Shard
categories.info: Used to increase the healing power of Bile Flasks when presented to [Our Lady of the Chalices](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509170).

categories.title: Sleeping Daughter
categories.info: Find Sleeping Daughters to unlock the [Mistress of Mourning](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520868)'s combat challenges.

categories.title: Tool
categories.info:
Tools can be given to [Montanes](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509092), with the ultimate reward being 5 Marks of Martyrdom and the ability to equip figures at any Prie Dieu. No matter which one you pick up, they are found in this order:
- Sculptor's Resonant Gavel
- Immaculate Mother-of-Pearl Gauge
- Silver Shell File
- Sculptor's Oils of the Blessed Mixture
- Sculptor's Tears of Sap

categories.title: Unfinished Lullaby
categories.info: Finding all five Unfinished Lullaby pages creates a new item. Bring it to the [Mother](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=509142) to begin a challenge with a unique reward.

categories.title: Wax Seed
categories.info: Bring all 6 Wax Seeds to [Cesareo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=522609) to receive the [Remembrance of Cesareo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523589).

categories.title: Fervent Kiss
categories.info: Bring Fervent Kisses to the [Holy Hand of Fervent Kisses](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520870) to increase your maximum Fervour.

categories.title: Mark of Martyrdom
categories.info: Can be used to increase the number of slots in your Altarpiece of Favours and unlock new Weapon Memories.

categories.title: Rosary Knot
categories.info: Bring Rosary Knots to [Sagrario](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520866) to unlock new slots for Rosary Beads.

categories.title: Bell
categories.info: Ring it with the [Veredicto](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=520284) or [Embrujo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=597335) to send out a wave that can create platforms / wall grates / emblems, and open doors.

categories.title: Dash Barrier
categories.info: Use the [Mercy of the Wind](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=522436) to get through barriers and lasers.

categories.title: Emblem
categories.info: Can be grappled to while holding the [Embrujo](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=597335).

categories.title: Golden Ornament
categories.info: After obtaining [Scions' Protection](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=522610), getting close to golden wisps will transform them into grabbable ornaments.

categories.title: Interactable
categories.template: Break the glass mechanism above to lower it.

categories.title: Living Barrier
categories.info: Broken with the [Ruego al Alba](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=519366), or with DLC installed, [Mea Culpa](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523994). You'll need to be fairly high in the air to build enough speed to destroy them.

categories.title: Mirror
categories.info: Hit mirrors with [Sarmiento & Centella](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=519396) to teleport in the direction of the beam of light.

categories.title: Thorn Barrier
categories.info: Thorn Barriers appear in the base game, but can only be navigated with [Mea Culpa](https://mapgenie.io/blasphemous-2/maps/cvstodia?locationIds=523994). locations.title: Domine
locations.description:
In New Game Plus, this statue offers challenges with six unique rewards based on your Retribution Level. The fancier the skull, the more rewards you'll unlock when beating the game. 
##

**Ultimate Torment**
  - Your penance starts again. You will lose all obtained items, weapons and upgrades from your previous playthrough.  _This challenge cannot be disabled._
  - worth 1 Retribution

**Final Judgment**
  - Enemies will be more challenging. Falling into chasms and thorns will lead to instant death.
  - worth 1 Retribution

**Vow of Poverty**
    - Fervour and rosary beads upgrades will remain locked.
    - worth 1 Retribution

**Spilled Blood**
  - Your health bar will be replaced by life orbs.
  - worth 1 Retribution

**Chalice of Guilt**
  - When you die, you will drop a single Guilt Fragment that will contain half of the Tears of Atonement and experience obtained.
  - worth 1 Retribution

**Ascension of Penance**
- Any hit you receive will increase your Guilt. In exchange, your attacks will be more powerful when you are free from guilt.
- worth 0.5 Retribution

**Peace for the Remorseful**
- Enemies will reappear if you leave and then return to their room. In exchange, you will have additional resistance to all elements.
- worth 0.5 Retribution

**Barefoot Procession**
- Any hit you receive will deplete your fervour bar. In exchange, fervour gains will increase.
- worth 0.5 Retribution

**Endless Thirst**
- You gain less experience in combat and will collect fewer Marks of Martyrdom. In exchange, the Altarpiece of Favours will be completely unlocked from the start.
- worth 0.5 Retribution

locations.title: Zejel of the Cruelest Thorn

locations.title: Carcelera of Bitter Blood

locations.title: Garrotin of The Forgotten Ones
locations.description:

locations.title: Ivy of Ascension
locations.description:

locations.title: Broken Step

locations.title: Passage of Ash

locations.title: Mercy of the Wind

locations.title: Price of Blood
